title: SOS
text:
← Back to ESD Data menu
  





The SOS group uses multiple autonomous marine platforms to gather physical, chemical, and biological ocean data. This data is essential for long-term ecosystem monitoring and supporting fisheries management in regions like the California Current and the Antarctic Peninsula.
Glider Lab Manual
Glider and Mooring Database

Glider & mooring devices/builds/deployments

SQL Server database on Estrella to track devices/builds. Access front end.

Front end: https://github.nmfs.local/sam-woodman/amlr-technology-database
Would looove to move away from SQL Server, and Access, to something more wholistic.

esdglider scrapes info from database

Fleet Status (working to move away from this)

Perhaps add who does what?

title: CalCOFI
text:
← Back to ESD Data menu
  






CalCOFI DB - Ichthyoplankton tows conducted using standardized CalCOFI methods (not just CalCOFI cruises proper, e.g. trawl cruises), 1951 to present. Primarily bongo tows but also manta, Calvet/pairovet, and a smattering of others.
SQL Server DB on estrella-g
CUFES - Continuous Underway Fish-Egg Sampler data, 1996-present. SQL Server DB on estrella-g
